candidates.transcript_evidence: And now moving on to something less emotional, we're just going to talk about electrical vehicles and different initiatives the government has to improve the usage of electrical vehicles.
candidates.description: 转向讨论电动汽车及政府改善其使用的举措

candidates.transcript_evidence: I don't know if you've heard, but there's this new policy that includes subsidise of up to £5,000 for electrical vehicles with a range of over 300 miles.
candidates.description: 提及一项新政策，为续航超过300英里的电动汽车提供最高5000英镑补贴

candidates.transcript_evidence: how do you think this will impact consumer behaviour?

candidates.transcript_evidence: When it comes to electrical vehicles in the UK. So what they're doing is they take £5,000 off or they give like a price of £5,000 for people that get an electrical car vehicle, electrical car vehicle, electrical car that needs to have more than 300 miles.
candidates.description: 解释补贴是直接减免5000英镑，但要求车辆续航超过300英里

candidates.transcript_evidence: So you should be able to go 300 miles before you have to charge it up.

candidates.transcript_evidence: No, no, when you buy the car.

candidates.transcript_evidence: But the car needs to be, the 300 miles is how long the car can go before you charge it up.

candidates.transcript_evidence: So do you think this will like make UK people use electrical vehicles more?

candidates.transcript_evidence: Probably new ones, I would assume.

candidates.transcript_evidence: Yeah, so that's one of the points you could make, like £5,000. When you buy such an expensive car could actually not make a big difference.
